overview.description: The Vanguard US High-Yield Corporate BD Index ETF (VCHY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund tracks a market-value weighted index of USD-denominated, high-yield corporate bonds, all with individual exposures capped at 2%. VCHY was launched on Jun 2, 2026 and is issued by Vanguard.
